mapper.insert: INSERT INTO addresses ( user_id, full_name, phone, address_line, city, pincode ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{fullName}, #{phone}, #{addressLine}, #{city}, #{pincode} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, full_name AS fullName, phone, address_line AS addressLine, city, pincode FROM addresses WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_active = TRUE ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE addresses SET full_name = #{fullName}, phone = #{phone}, address_line = #{addressLine}, city = #{city}, pincode = #{pincode} WHERE id = #{id}
